messages:
Maya: Quick thread to lock scope for the long-term routing roadmap. Need the launch matrix (pilot -> beta -> GA), owners, and a short list of gating metrics. Try to keep asks actionable.

Devon: Proposed 3-lane model: pilot lanes (policy-only soft isolation), economic lanes (quota + cache reservations), sovereign lanes (physical, VPC-level). Pilot should be feature-flagged and cheap to iterate on.

Eli: Agree. For pilot we need policy-as-code (v0.3) + linter rules so engineers don't push incompatible routes. Also add a canary harness that replays regional traffic.

Sam: Ops constraints: gating metrics for GA should be simple: 1) p99 latency within 2x baseline under normal load, 2) KV-cache hit >= 85% for cached workloads, 3) no >1% sustained eviction rate, 4) successful rollback test in staging.

Anna: CS asks: pilot customers must sign an opt-in migration checklist (data residency, expected cutover window, test prompts). We'll need 2 pilot customers per region to consider regional GA.

Devon: Rolling timeline sketch: pilot (3w monitoring) -> beta (open to paid customers, 4w) -> GA (after two regional betas meet SLOs). Pricing bands map to lanes: economic = lower cost with soft guarantees, sovereign = premium.

Maya: Short policy DSL example to attach to the playbook (informal):
```yaml
policy_name: lane-alpha
lane_type: economic
reserves:
  cpu_pct: 10
  kv_cache_mb: 512
fallback: variant_compat
canary: true
```

Eli: We'll add validation so reserves can't be set <2% or >50% of node. Also include a warning if kv_cache_mb > pool size.

Sam: Action items: I'll create a canary capacity reservation and synthetic noisy tenant (ticket INF-8803). We'll run eviction drills in staging before pilot.

Devon: I'll own policy-as-code prototype and entitlement mapping (ticket PLAT-822). Maya: can you finalize the launch brief with GA gating?

Maya: Will do. Draft GA gating for review: 1) two paying customers per region on beta for >=28 days with SLOs met; 2) rollback drill success in staging; 3) docs + migration playbook published; 4) billing meter + contract language for lanes completed.

Anna: Confirmed. I'll recruit pilot customers and collect migration windows. Note customers want at least 10 business days notice for major cutovers.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: maintenance window Wed 01:00-02:00 UTC — avoid beta cutovers then.

Maya: Great. We'll reconvene Thursday to sign off owners and timelines. Thanks :zap:.
